Интерлейкин-12 Edodekin Alfa (USAN, rINN) Edodekina alfa; Édodékine Alfa; Edodekinum Alfa; Ro-24- 7472/000. Эдодекин Альфа CAS — 187348-17-0. Description. A recombinant human interleukin-12. Profile Interleukin-12 is one of a number of polypeptides known collec- tively as interleukins (p.2325). It is produced by macrophages and dendritic cells and enhances cellular immunity through in- duction of the activity of interferon-γ and cytotoxic T-lym- phocytes. It has been investigated for the treatment of severe in- fections such as mycobacterial infections; it is worthy of note that children with a rare inherited susceptibility to fatal mycobac- terial infections exhibit mutations in the interleukin-12 gene. In- terleukin-12 is also under study for the treatment of various can- cers, including as adenovirus-mediated gene therapy. Edodekin alfa is human recombinant interleukin-12 under inves- tigation for the treatment of renal cell carcinoma. ◊ References. 1. Mazzolini G
